title: Metro Line 1 Delay
description: Signalling fault causing delays of 10–15 minutes on Metro Line 1 between Andheri and Ghatkopar stations. Technicians are on site. Estimated resolution: 11:30 AM. Passengers are advised to use Bus Route 78 as an alternative or take the Western Railway suburban train from Andheri Station.

title: Bus Route 22 Diversion — Bandra
description: Due to the Bandra-Worli Sea Link road work, Bus Route 22 will be diverted via SV Road between Khar Road Junction and Bandra Station from 09:00 AM to 02:00 PM today. Expect additional travel time of 8–12 minutes. Stop 'Khar Road Junction' is temporarily shifted 400 m east to SV Road.
short_description: Bus Route 22 diverted via SV Road near Bandra due to Sea Link roadwork. Expect 8–12 min extra...

title: Rapid Line 3 — Full Day Cancellation
description: Rapid Line 3 (BKC to Thane) is completely cancelled for today due to an emergency inspection of the dedicated lane infrastructure between Kurla and Vikhroli. All scheduled departures are cancelled. Passengers are advised to use Kurla Station (CR) for Thane-bound suburban trains.

title: Planned Maintenance — Rapid Line Weekend
description: Rapid Line 3 will undergo scheduled track maintenance on April 19–20 (Saturday–Sunday) between BKC Bus Terminal and Kurla Station. Services will be suspended from 10:00 PM Saturday to 6:00 AM Sunday. Early-morning Sunday departures from BKC will not operate. Plan alternate travel accordingly.
short_description: Rapid Line 3 suspended Apr 19 10 PM to Apr 20 6 AM for scheduled track maintenance at BKC–Kurla...

title: Bus Stop Relocation — Malad Market
description: The Malad Market bus stop on Bus Route 45 will be permanently relocated 150 m north (outside Malad Railway Station West exit) from April 21 onwards. The new stop has a shelter and real-time display board. The old stop position will be decommissioned.
short_description: Malad Market stop on BUS-45 relocating 150 m north from April 21. New stop near Malad Station...

title: Metro Signal Upgrade — Completed
description: The planned CBTC signalling upgrade on Metro Line 1 between Versova and DN Nagar was completed successfully on April 13. All services have resumed normal schedule. Frequency has improved from 8 minutes to 6 minutes during peak hours as a result of this upgrade.
short_description: Metro Line 1 signal upgrade completed. Frequency improved to 6 min during peak hours...

title: Borivali Station — Lift Out of Service
description: The passenger lift at Borivali Station West bus stop is currently under repair. Passengers requiring accessibility assistance should use the ramp at the south entrance. The lift is expected to be restored by April 16.
